Hi Sophia — thanks for the packet, and welcome. Below is the minimal vendor master payload we'll need to create the record and route POs/invoices correctly: 

Required fields (please confirm exactly as they appear on legal/tax docs):
- Legal entity name: (as on Certificate of Incorporation / W-9)
- Tax ID / EIN:
- Registered address (legal) and remit-to address (if different)
- Primary AP invoice email (where automated invoice system will deliver)
- PO contact name and PO contact email (who receives purchase orders)
- Billing phone and AP contact name (optional but helpful)
- Preferred payment method: ACH / Wire / Check + ACH remittance details if ACH

For PO naming: we don't require a prefix from vendors; Redwood generates POs with our internal PO number. For routing, please provide the single PO contact email you'd like us to send POs to (we can also CC a distribution list). We prefer invoices sent to invoicing@redwood-ap.com but will accept vendor-submitted invoices to their chosen AP email — we just need to record the authoritative invoice address in the vendor profile.

If you can reply with the exact legal name and attach the W-9 and certificate here (or upload to the Drive link below), I'll kick off vendor creation and loop in our AP ops owner (Marissa) to confirm payment terms and ACH setup.
